title: Motorbike Controller Subsystem Static Attributes
description: Static attributes of the motorbike control system, responsible for handling driving inputs, steering control, etc., including motorbike-specific tilt angle limitations.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference path, used for editor intelligent suggestions and validation

basic_durability.description: Subsystem basic durability, becomes paralyzed when reduced to 0, restores functionality when repaired to 30% durability.

steering_center.description: Steering center position, relative to the part's local coordinate system.

oneOf.description: Steering radius, in meters, used to calculate steering angle. Supports single value input or speed-radius mapping table.
Speed-steering radius mapping table, where keys are speed (km/h) and values are corresponding steering radius (meters). Supports linear interpolation.

steering_radius.description: Steering radius, in meters, used to calculate steering angle. Supports single value input or speed-radius mapping table.

manual_gear_shift.description: Whether to enable manual gear shifting. If false, automatic shifting is used.

auto_hand_brake.description: Whether to automatically apply handbrake. Automatically applies handbrake when vehicle is stationary and no input is given.

control_inputs.description: List of control input signal keys, from highest to lowest priority.

abs_enabled.description: Whether to enable Anti-lock Braking System (ABS).

abs_target_slip_ratio.description: ABS target slip ratio, typically set between 0.1-0.2. ABS reduces braking force when slip ratio is too high.

abs_wheel_radius.description: Wheel radius in meters, used to calculate wheel linear speed and slip ratio.

max_angle.description: Tilt angle beyond which the motorbike is considered to have lost balance and will no longer apply correction forces, in degrees.

parking_angle.description: Target tilt angle when the motorbike is parked, can be positive or negative, in degrees. Positive values indicate left tilt, negative values indicate right tilt.

correction_force_multiplier.description: Correction force multiplier, used to scale the overall balance adjustment force of the motorbike control system.
